name: Diagnostic Public View
description: Client accesses the public diagnostic page via UUID link and navigates the JSON-driven section components (Purpose/Radiography/Categories/DeliveryStructure/ExecutiveSummary/Cost/Timeline/Scope). Initial-phase view hides `final`-only sections. Per-section dwell time is tracked via /api/diagnostics/public/<uuid>/track-section/. Accept/Reject is a separate flow (`diagnostic-public-respond`). Since the Jul 2026 redesign the page opens with a personalized cover ('Comenzar recorrido' starts the tour) and sections swap with a directional slide.
